agent_report.summary: Merged PR #29 (pt-BR translation slice 1) after verifying all ten of Issue #26's acceptance criteria, confirming no tests were deleted, skipped or loosened (73 tests, up from 69), and opening the CI browser-evidence screenshots to check the 360px and 1280px layouts. Codex had left no findings. With work in flight back to zero, I labelled Issue #27 (slice 2: runtime strings in app.js/state.js) ready, since a half-translated interface is the largest remaining gap to GOAL.md, and added a note about the much longer 'Trazer para este dia' label. The screenshots revealed that the wider 'Adicionar' button now squeezes add-form text inputs into truncating their placeholders at 1280px; that shares a root cause with the Commitments defect already tracked in #22, so I appended two criteria there rather than opening a duplicate. The project is not DONE: the interface is deliberately part-English until slices 2 (#27) and 3 (#28) land, so no DONE Issue was created.
